text:
By Entrepreneur Store ,
12 hours ago
Two important parts of running a business are managing costs and protecting your company, and that goes for software too, even at the most fundamental level. If you’re still paying for a Microsoft 365 subscription, then part of your budget is always going to be eaten up by fees that might increase at any time. And if you’re still running devices with Windows 10, then your entire network may be vulnerable. However, there’s a simple fix for both.
This Microsoft Bundle gives you lifetime access to Microsoft Office and Windows 11 Pro without requiring any ongoing fees. Instead, you pay a one-time flat fee that’s marked down right now from $448.99 to $104.99.
What’s included This is a two-part bundle giving you lifetime access to Microsoft Office 2024 Home and Business and Windows 11 Pro.
This Office license comes with
Word Excel PowerPoint Outlook OneNote These are recently updated versions of the core Microsoft apps. That means Excel is better equipped to handle larger datasets and multiple workbooks without slowing down as quickly. PowerPoint now supports recording presentations with voice, video, and captions, which is useful for internal updates, client walkthroughs, and remote communication. Outlook also has stronger accessibility checks, so teams can catch formatting and clarity issues before sending messages.
Across the suite, the interface is more consistent and collaboration tools like comments, co-authoring, and version history help keep shared work more organized.
Windows 11 Pro is a significant upgrade compared to Windows 10 or even Windows 11 Home. This OS gives you a cleaner interface and better multitasking tools, but the bigger difference is in security and control. Snap Layouts makes it easier to keep work organized across multiple open windows. BitLocker encrypts the drive, which helps protect business data if a device is lost or stolen. Hyper-V lets you run virtual machines, and Windows Sandbox gives you a separate environment for testing files or software without putting the main system at risk.
Right now, it’s only $104.99 to get both Microsoft Office 2024 and Windows 11 Pro for life.
Offer ends soon.
